title: Reproducible supported runtime for release certification
statement: Package 01 implementation environment was Node 22/npm 10 while the supported contract targets Node 24/npm 11+, and clean dependency installation did not complete; release certification remains blocked until tested in the supported environment.
decision_impact: Blocks release certification until supported Node/npm and dependency installation are reproducible.

title: Package 02 operational auth bootstrap details
statement: Exact bootstrap/session/organization-membership implementation details must be confirmed against the chosen Supabase project/environment before enabling auth paths.
decision_impact: Affects safe enablement order for Auth/Organization bootstrap in Package 02.
